meaning: A way to scramble data so only approved people can read it.
clues: It is a way to protect information.
It helps keep information safe from people who should not see it.
It scrambles readable information so a person needs the right key to read it.
The scrambled version makes no sense to anyone without the key.
Its name starts with E and has ten letters.
assumes: A password is a secret word or set of characters used to prove who you are
A firewall helps control access to a network
A screen PIN is a short code that opens a device

decoys.meaning: A secret word or set of characters used to prove who you are.
